title: Finite cohomology below a pseudo-coherent bound
statement: Let R be a ring and m an integer. Call an object C of D(R) m-pseudo-coherent if there are a bounded complex E^\bullet of finite free R-modules and a morphism E^\bullet\to C in D(R) inducing isomorphisms H^i(E^\bullet)\to H^i(C) for i>m and a surjection H^m(E^\bullet)\to H^m(C). If K is a complex of R-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], viewed as an object of D(R) [def-pc-derived-category], which is m-pseudo-coherent and satisfies H^i(K)=0 for every i>m, then H^m(K) is a finite type R-module.
